entry_points.text: Flat entry reserves stack, loads libs, builds tables; misc probe checks enabled match and branches loader transparent ordinary; dir exposes lookup unlink seq open.
Misc and script init and exit install and remove formats and fs type draining callbacks; deferred destroy releases super; device completions unwrap buffers and dispatch sync or async finish.

Block entries obtain, sync read, readahead and boundary flush; buffered write prepares via begin; mkwrite locks validates commits dirties waits; expand writes zero length; char open probes; fd replace grows locked.

exports.text: Exec helpers copy kernel strings to stack, drop argv zero, replace interp names, format seq output with overflow pinning, and open seq contexts.
Super teardown quiesces writeback, runs hooks, publishes dying and frees anon devnos; registry matches names exactly; sync writes inodes, hooks, device and waits.
Block services look up by dev block size, sync read, readahead, dirty single and folio ranges with inode propagation, alloc and free descriptors and chains, and reclaim only idle members.
Char registry splits majors and reserves legacy ranges; cdev add maps spans; xattr resolves handlers; BPF file pipe acquire exe, open dentries and build FIFOs under limits.

hazards.text: Faults abort exec; transparent marks after open and loader decline fails; staged args reject loader transparent; registration bounds patterns and delimiters; bind enable remove recheck publish with ns size offset risks.

Incomplete eviction poisons linkages; sync failures stop later phases; scripts never run truncated tokens; removal omits post hook to avoid deadlock; sibling finish needs lock; migration folios rejected; writes stick errors.

Zero-ref release, freeing with association, overflow ranges and misaligned sizes warn or fail; reclaim forbids unlocked or writeback folios; LRU residency pins folios; beyond-size blocks cleaned not written; invalid busy overlap rollback.

invariants.text: Flat loader refreshes lib cells in fixed windows, walks GOT to sentinel preserving zeros, flushes cache; arg stack validates lengths and limits and serves pages by map or table.
Misc entries match by masked magic, suffix or BPF; registration scans escapes, checks offsets, requires absolute loader or cred paths, starts with one ref; binding needs plus and caps.
Seq pins on overflow and drops when full; inodes alloc init enroll with deferred free; exclusive lookup uses cache and refuses dead dirs; reads honor offsets; names salt-hash.
Fresh super starts biased refs, neutral backing, empty lists and freeze levels; background writeback is tagged budgeted nonblocking while full sync blocks; BPF misc needs match and load.
LRU hits move to front with extra ref else slow path installs; begin creates buffers, zeroes fresh partials and reads boundaries; majors hash by mod; corename grows high-water; fd tables stay pow2.

locks.text: Misc lookup uses SRCU with ordered publish and live refs skipping dying; last release defers reclaim; sb list, registry, BPF ops and super protection use dedicated locks with dying wait.

Buffers use sleepable lock bit with try and wait; per-CPU LRU uses irq or preempt exclusion and skips isolated or disabled caches; folio lock pins create begin commit read; metadata exclusion serializes claim.
Reclaim and sync need exclusive protection with RCU-safe walks and rescheduling; char uses mutex plus spin with module pinning; pipe and program dentry mutation hold inode or pipe mutex.

state_machines.text: Misc entries stay unpublished until first enable inserts once, searchable while enabled, leave by remove bulk unlink evict; mounts share by ns reusing live else nascent with fill teardown.
Super moves born active to dying broadcast then dead where acquires fail; inodes evict only on double zero refs; scripts need magic and completeness; last async sibling completes folio.

Full writeback ensures buffers, cleans beyond EOF, maps, starts writeback and records errors; extents cover hole delay unwritten mapped; acquire hits reuse else grows; dirty moves buffer to folio to inode.
Char ranges reject bad spans and overlaps with sorted splice; open reuses cached else installs; coredump selects pipe socket file with expansion; stashed dentries adopt RCU else publish with retry.

structs.text: Flags pair chars with bits; entries hold hash, magic, mask, interp or BPF, bound list, use count and reclaim; state bits track enabled magic BPF; tables expose entry register status sb ops.
Super carries protection, links, lists, ops, bounds and counters; work carries target mode budget tagging reason; LRU holds sixteen pointers per CPU; buffers form uniform circular ring with flags.
Char map holds major name legacy base span in 255 buckets; coredump scalars hold pattern size pipe counts and type codes; xattr encodings cover removal and errors; kernfs attrs hold ownership times.
